entry.en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months after the date you arrive in the Central African Republic.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe tener una validez de al menos 6 meses después de la fecha de llegada a la República Centroafricana.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: You will be denied entry without a valid travel document or with a passport reported lost or stolen.
entry.es: Se te negará la entrada sin un documento de viaje válido o con un pasaporte denunciado como perdido o robado.
entry.quote: You will be denied entry if you do not have a valid travel document or try to use a passport that has been reported lost or stolen.

entry.en: To pass border control you must have a certificate proving a yellow fever vaccination.
entry.es: Para pasar el control fronterizo debes tener un certificado que acredite la vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination.

entry.en: There are strict rules about goods taken in or out, and you must declare anything prohibited or subject to tax or duty.
entry.es: Hay normas estrictas sobre los bienes que se entran o sacan y debes declarar todo lo prohibido o sujeto a impuestos.
entry.quote: There are strict rules about goods you can take into or out of the Central African Republic. You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

entry.en: There is an export tax on cultural artefacts.
entry.es: Hay un impuesto de exportación sobre los artefactos culturales.
entry.quote: There is an export tax on cultural artefacts.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel to the whole country, including Bimbo, Begoua and Coline, except to the capital, Bangui.
safety.es: FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a todo el país, incluidas Bimbo, Begoua y Coline, salvo a la capital, Bangui.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to the whole of the Central African Republic, including the areas of Bimbo, Begoua and Coline, except to the capital, Bangui.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all but essential travel to Bangui, including its international airport.
safety.es: FCDO desaconseja todo viaje no esencial a Bangui, incluido su aeropuerto internacional.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all but essential travel to Bangui, including Bangui M’Poko International Airport.

safety.en: Outside Bangui security is extremely unstable, and armed groups occupy areas in the north and south east.
safety.es: Fuera de Bangui la seguridad es sumamente inestable y grupos armados ocupan zonas del norte y el sureste.
safety.quote: Outside of Bangui, security conditions are extremely unstable. Armed groups continue to occupy areas in the north and south east of the country.

safety.en: Armed personnel control official and illegal roadblocks where you may be asked for a bribe.
safety.es: Personal armado controla retenes oficiales e ilegales donde pueden pedirte un soborno.
safety.quote: Armed personnel control roadblocks (both official and illegal) where you may be asked for a bribe.

safety.en: Theft and robbery are common, and armed gangs operate in the outlying areas of Bangui, especially the PK5 district.
safety.es: Los robos son comunes y bandas armadas operan en las afueras de Bangui, especialmente en el distrito PK5.
safety.quote: Theft and robbery are common, and armed gangs operate in the outlying areas of Bangui, especially in the PK5 district.

safety.en: By law you must always carry ID, such as a certified copy of your passport or a residence permit.
safety.es: Por ley debes llevar siempre identificación, como una copia certificada de tu pasaporte o un permiso de residencia.
safety.quote: You must always carry ID by law, such as a certified copy of your passport or a residence permit.

health.en: There are very few healthcare facilities, and those in Bangui are very basic.
health.es: Hay muy pocos centros de salud y los de Bangui son muy básicos.
health.quote: There are very few healthcare facilities in the Central African Republic. Facilities in Bangui are very basic.

health.en: Make sure you have travel health insurance and funds covering treatment abroad and repatriation, including air ambulance evacuation.
health.es: Asegúrate de tener seguro médico de viaje y fondos que cubran el tratamiento en el extranjero y la repatriación, incluida la evacuación en ambulancia aérea.
health.quote: Make sure you have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover the cost of any medical treatment abroad and repatriation, including medical evacuation by air ambulance.

health.en: Listed health risks include yellow fever, malaria, cholera, Zika virus and mpox.
health.es: Entre los riesgos de salud figuran la fiebre amarilla, la malaria, el cólera, el virus del Zika y la mpox.
health.quote:
health risks you’ll face in the Central African Republic, including:

- yellow fever

- malaria

- cholera

- Zika virus

- mpox

health.en: The DRC Ministry of Health announced an outbreak of Ebola Bundibugyo in Ituri Province in the north-east.
health.es: El Ministerio de Salud de la RDC anunció un brote de ébola Bundibugyo en la provincia de Ituri, en el noreste.
health.quote: announced an outbreak of Ebola Bundibugyo in the North-Eastern Ituri Province.

health.en: Water purity is not reliable, so it is safer to buy bottled water or boil or filter water.
health.es: La pureza del agua no es fiable, así que es más seguro comprar agua embotellada o hervir o filtrar el agua.
health.quote: the purity of the water is not reliable and thus it is safer to buy bottled water, or boil or filter water.

health.en: All food should be cooked or peeled, particularly food from local markets where hygiene is a concern.
health.es: Toda la comida debe estar cocida o pelada, sobre todo la de los mercados locales, donde la higiene es un problema.
health.quote: All food should be cooked or peeled prior to being served, particularly food purchased at local markets, where hygiene is a concern.

help.en: You can call 117 for ambulance, fire and police.
help.es: Puedes llamar al 117 para ambulancia, bomberos y policía.

help.en: Emergency numbers are unreliable and the services are unlikely to respond outside Bangui.
help.es: Los números de emergencia no son fiables y es poco probable que los servicios respondan fuera de Bangui.
help.quote: Emergency numbers are unreliable in the Central African Republic. The emergency services are unlikely to respond outside Bangui.

getting_in.en: The only international airport is Bangui M'Poko International Airport (BGF).
getting_in.es: El único aeropuerto internacional es el Aeropuerto Internacional Bangui M'Poko (BGF).
getting_in.quote: The country's only international airport (and only airport with scheduled flights) is Bangui M'Poko International Airport (BGF IATA).

getting_in.en: Air France provides the only service to Europe, flying to Paris.
getting_in.es: Air France ofrece el único servicio a Europa, con vuelos a París.
getting_in.quote: Air France provides the only service to Europe, flying to Paris.

getting_in.en: Bus service is available from Cameroon and Chad, but the length and dangerous countryside make trips infrequent.
getting_in.es: Hay servicio de autobús desde Camerún y Chad, pero la distancia y el campo peligroso hacen que los viajes sean poco frecuentes.
getting_in.quote: Bus service is available from Cameroon and Chad, although the length and the dangerous countryside makes such bus trips infrequent.

getting_in.en: Barges with no set schedule travel from Bangui to Kinshasa/Brazzaville.
getting_in.es: Hay barcazas sin horario fijo que viajan de Bangui a Kinshasa/Brazzaville.
getting_in.quote: there are regular (although adhering to no set schedule) barges which travel from Bangui to Kinshasa/Brazzaville.

getting_in.en: Land travel across the borders with Chad, Sudan, South Sudan and the DRC (east of Bangui) is not recommended because they are very insecure.
getting_in.es: No se recomienda cruzar por tierra las fronteras con Chad, Sudán, Sudán del Sur y la RDC (al este de Bangui) por ser muy inseguras.
getting_in.quote: Borders with Chad, Sudan, South Sudan, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo (at least east of Bangui) are very insecure and any attempt to travel across them by land is not recommended.

getting_in.en: There are no land routes between the CAR and Congo-Brazzaville.
getting_in.es: No hay rutas terrestres entre la República Centroafricana y Congo-Brazzaville.
getting_in.quote: There are no land routes between the CAR and Congo-Brazzaville (Republic of the Congo).

getting_around.en: Taxis make getting around the capital easy, but the fare must be negotiated before departure as there are no taximeters.
getting_around.es: Los taxis facilitan moverse por la capital, pero la tarifa debe negociarse antes de salir porque no hay taxímetros.
getting_around.quote: Getting around in the capital is easy with taxis, which make large parts of the city accessible. The fare must be negotiated before departure, there are no taximeters.

getting_around.en: Shared taxis operate on fixed routes between major locations within cities and to nearby towns.
getting_around.es: Los taxis compartidos operan en rutas fijas entre lugares importantes de las ciudades y localidades cercanas.
getting_around.quote: Shared taxis operate on fixed routes, commonly between major locations within cities and to nearby towns, and stop at designated points to pick up and drop off passengers.

getting_around.en: Travel by bus can be risky, especially for foreigners.
getting_around.es: Viajar en autobús puede ser arriesgado, especialmente para extranjeros.
getting_around.quote: travel by bus can be risky, especially for foreigners.

getting_around.en: Yango is a ride-hailing company whose availability you can check in Bangui or other major cities.
getting_around.es: Yango es una empresa de transporte con conductor cuya disponibilidad puedes consultar en Bangui u otras ciudades importantes.
getting_around.quote: Yango is a ride-hailing company based in the United Arab Emirates. You can check its availability in Bangui or other major cities.

getting_around.en: Roads are in extremely poor condition, most are unpaved and may close at short notice and require a 4-wheel-drive vehicle.
getting_around.es: Las carreteras están en pésimas condiciones, casi todas sin pavimentar, pueden cerrar sin aviso y requieren un vehículo 4x4.
getting_around.quote: Roads are in extremely poor condition, especially in the rainy season from May to November. Most roads are unpaved, may close at short notice and require a 4-wheel-drive vehicle.

getting_around.en: It is advisable to have an off-road vehicle and an experienced tour guide to reach the provinces.
getting_around.es: Se aconseja tener un vehículo todoterreno y un guía turístico con experiencia para llegar a las provincias.
getting_around.quote: It is advisable to have an off-road vehicle and an experienced tour guide.

money.en: The currency is the Central African CFA franc (FCFA, code XAF).
money.es: La moneda es el franco CFA centroafricano (FCFA, código XAF).
money.quote: The currency of the country is the Central African CFA franc, denoted FCFA (ISO currency code: XAF).

money.en: Both CFA franc currencies are fixed at 1 euro = 655.957 CFA francs.
money.es: Ambos francos CFA están fijados en 1 euro = 655,957 francos CFA.
money.quote: Both currencies are fixed at a rate of 1 euro = 655.957 CFA francs.

money.en: It is easier to exchange euros for Central African francs than US dollars.
money.es: Es más fácil cambiar euros por francos centroafricanos que dólares estadounidenses.
money.quote: It is easier to exchange euros for Central African francs rather than US dollars.

money.en: There are very few ATMs and most places, including hotels, do not accept international credit or debit cards.
money.es: Hay muy pocos cajeros y la mayoría de los lugares, incluidos hoteles, no aceptan tarjetas internacionales.
money.quote: There are very few ATMs. Most places, including hotels, do not accept international credit or debit cards.

money.en: Costs are exorbitant for foreigners who want a lifestyle similar to that of their home country.
money.es: Los costos son exorbitantes para extranjeros que quieran un estilo de vida similar al de su país de origen.
money.quote: Costs in the Central African Republic are exorbitant for foreigners who plan to maintain a lifestyle similar to those in their origin country.

etiquette.en: Locals often eat with their hands, and if you do too you should eat with your right hand.
etiquette.es: Los lugareños suelen comer con las manos y, si tú también lo haces, debes comer con la mano derecha.
etiquette.quote: The locals often eat with their hands. If you are eating with them, and using your hands as well, eat with your right hand.

etiquette.en: Taking photos conspicuously warrants permission from anyone you intend to photograph, even in public places.
etiquette.es: Tomar fotos de forma visible requiere el permiso de quien quieras fotografiar, incluso en lugares públicos.
etiquette.quote: Taking photos conspicuously warrants permission from anyone you intend to photograph, even in public places.
